# ZELLIO — Full Documentation

> ZELLIO is a software house and digital engineering agency based in Indonesia. ZELLIO designs and develops websites, web applications, business systems, dashboards, mobile applications, SaaS platforms, and other digital products for businesses and organizations.

This document provides detailed information about ZELLIO, its services, engineering capabilities, development approach, technologies, project types, and contact information.

---

## 1. About ZELLIO

ZELLIO is a software house and digital engineering agency based in East Jakarta, Indonesia.

ZELLIO works with businesses and organizations to design, develop, and improve digital products and software systems based on their business requirements, operational workflows, users, and technical needs.

The company's services cover both digital presence and software engineering, ranging from professional company websites to web applications, internal business systems, dashboards, mobile applications, SaaS products, and enterprise software.

ZELLIO's approach is focused on building digital products that are reliable, maintainable, scalable, and aligned with the way a business actually operates.

ZELLIO serves businesses in Indonesia as well as international clients.

## Website Development

ZELLIO provides website development services for companies, organizations, brands, and businesses that need a professional digital presence.

Website projects may include:

- UI/UX design

- Performance optimization
- Analytics integration
- Deployment

The website is developed according to the client's brand, content requirements, target audience, business goals, and technical requirements.

# 3. Engineering Capabilities

ZELLIO works across multiple layers of software development.

## Frontend Development

Frontend development may include:

- Responsive interfaces
- Component-based architecture
- Interactive interfaces
- Web applications
- Performance optimization
- Accessibility considerations

## Backend Development

Backend development may include:

- Business logic
- REST APIs
- Authentication
- Authorization
- Database integration
- Background processing
- Notifications
- Third-party integrations

## API Development & Integration

ZELLIO can develop and integrate APIs for connecting applications and business systems.

Examples include:

- REST APIs
- WebSockets
- Internal APIs
- Third-party APIs
- Payment integrations
- Messaging integrations
- Authentication integrations

## Database Engineering

Database work may include:

- Database architecture
- Data modeling
- Query optimization
- Data relationships
- Database security
- Performance optimization
- Migration planning

## System Integration

ZELLIO can connect new applications with existing systems and third-party services where required.

## Cloud & Deployment

Deployment can involve cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and production configuration depending on project requirements.

Security and software quality are considered throughout development.

- Secure authentication

- Input sanitization

- JWT-based authentication
- Dependency management
- Application testing
- Security review
- Production configuration review

The objective is to build systems that remain reliable and maintainable as they evolve.

# 6. Development Process

ZELLIO uses a structured development process that can be adapted according to project size and requirements.

## Stage 1 — Discovery & Requirements

The project begins by understanding:

- Business objectives
- Existing processes
- User requirements
- Problems to be solved
- Project scope
- Functional requirements
- Technical requirements
- Integrations
- Constraints
- Priorities

## Stage 2 — Planning & Architecture

The team defines the technical and product direction.

This may include:

- System architecture
- Application modules
- Database structure
- User roles
- Permissions
- API requirements
- Technical roadmap
- Infrastructure planning

## Stage 3 — UI/UX Design

The product interface is designed around users, information architecture, and business workflows.

This may include:

- Wireframes
- User flows
- High-fidelity UI
- Interactive prototypes
- Responsive layouts
- Design systems

## Stage 4 — Development

Engineering includes the implementation of:

- Frontend
- Backend
- APIs
- Database
- Authentication
- Authorization
- Business logic
- Integrations
- Infrastructure

## Stage 5 — QA & Testing

The application is reviewed and tested for:

- Functional correctness
- User flows
- Responsive behavior
- Browser compatibility
- Application performance
- Security
- Authentication
- Authorization
- Data handling
- Reliability

## Stage 6 — Deployment

The application is prepared and deployed to the appropriate production environment.

## Stage 7 — Maintenance & Evolution

After launch, software may continue to evolve through:

- Bug fixes
- Performance improvements
- Feature development
- Security updates
- System improvements
- Infrastructure changes
- Business requirement changes
